blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) will start interviewing candidates for the position of chief justice on Oct. 22 (Thursday). The interviews will begin the two most senior incumbent Supreme Court (SC) justices – Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen and Associate Justice Alfredo Benjamin Caguioa. The Supreme Court said the interviews will be open for viewing to the media. Leonen and Caguioa will be given at least three hours in their interview. Both were appointees of the late President Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III. They will be followed by the interviews on Oct. 26 (Monday) of three other sitting high court […]...
